integrity: Explicit hypotheses and an all-sizes proof; finite computational checks are supplementary. Novelty compared against identified full primary manuscripts and published indexed summaries; unindexed literature may overlap.
scientific_limitations: Finitary propositional nonemptiness logic with lax splitting and all teams, including empty; no extension to strict-split, modal or richer team-atom languages. Program tests small finite universes only; mathematical proof handles all input sizes.
title: Sharp counterteam bound and coNP-complete entailment in propositional nonemptiness logic
